about.title: Your roof in the hands of a
about.p1: The business is run by Tomo Pšeničnik, a certified master sheet metal worker and roofer. Since 2010, together with our team, we have been covering, renovating and maintaining roofs in Libeliče, Dravograd and the surrounding area, as well as in neighbouring Carinthia.
about.p2: Every roof is different. That is why we always tailor the solution to the house, how it is used and your budget. We work as if it were our own.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Answers to the questions customers ask us most often before work begins.

items.q: How much does a new roof or re-roofing cost?
items.a: The price depends on the size and shape of the roof, the chosen roof covering and the condition of the roof truss. That is why we first inspect and measure the roof and then prepare a quote for your house.

items.q: Which roof covering should I choose?
items.a: We work with clay, concrete, metal, bitumen and fibre cement roofing, as well as stone-coated metal roof panels. We advise you based on roof pitch, snow load, the look of the house and your budget.

items.q: Do you take care of all the work on the roof?
items.a: Yes. We do the roofing, sheet metal and carpentry work, roof windows, lightning protection and work at height ourselves, so you don't need any other contractors.
The start date depends on the season and the scope of the work. We agree on the work date together with the quote and we stick to it.

items.q: Do you issue an inspection certificate for lightning protection?
items.a: Yes. After installation we measure the system and issue a certificate confirming the lightning protection system is in proper order.

items.q: Do you also work in Austria?
items.a: Yes. Besides Libeliče, Dravograd, Ravne na Koroškem, Prevalje, Vuzenica and the surrounding area, we also work in neighbouring Carinthia.
